steps.grandStaff: Piano music joins the two staves with a brace: the grand staff. The right hand reads the treble staff on top, the left hand the bass staff below, and middle {c} sits between them.
steps.quizGrand: Landmarks from both staves: play each note you see.
steps.takingTurns: The hands take turns: the right hand plays on the treble staff, then the left answers on the bass staff. Both play the last note together.
steps.inTime: Now in time with the metronome.
